items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Robert Moten was the new principal.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Did you ever get to know Booker T. Washington to see him or ...
No, by the time my mother and my brother and I had joined my father at Tuskegee, Booker T. Washington had died, and Robert Moten was the new principal.
